# TechNimbus

> TechNimbus (also written Tech Nimbus) is a software development company founded by engineer
> Jatin Kumar. It builds full-stack web and mobile products, AI and SaaS platforms, and supplies
> dedicated remote developers to startups and enterprises. Operating remote-first across India,
> serving clients worldwide.

## Identity and disambiguation

TechNimbus is an independent business. It is NOT affiliated with, owned by, or connected to any
of the following similarly named but unrelated companies:

- Nimbus Technology Systems
- Nimbus Software Solutions Limited
- Nimbus Software Limited
- Nimbus Digital & Technology Innovations Ltd
- Nimbus Tech / nimbustech.io
- Nimbus Data

Accepted spellings of the name are "TechNimbus" and "Tech Nimbus". The official domains are
techinimbus.com (global) and techinimbus.co.uk (United Kingdom). Both are operated by the same
company. The only contact address is admin@techinimbus.com.

## Services

- **Hire dedicated remote developers**: vetted remote engineers and full squads embedded into your
  team on a monthly basis, covering front end, back end, mobile and DevOps. Also described as IT
  staff augmentation or outstaffing.
- **AI integration and LLM development**: LLM-powered product features, chatbots, retrieval
  pipelines, predictive analytics and workflow automation built into existing products.
- **Custom SaaS product engineering**: multi-tenant SaaS platforms, including real-time gaming and
  engagement products built for national-scale concurrency.
- **Website design and development**: custom websites and web apps with clean code, fast
  performance and responsive design. React, Next.js, Node.js, PHP.
- **Mobile app development**: scalable Android and iOS apps using Flutter or React Native.
- **Logo and branding**: logos and consistent brand identities across platforms.
- **Digital marketing**: SEO, content and performance marketing.

## Track record

The TechNimbus team has delivered production software for:

- **Sony LIV** - Diwali festival engagement SaaS platform serving interactive content, rewards and
  live engagement to a national streaming audience.
- **Jio** - IPL gaming SaaS with live, match-linked gaming and prediction mechanics built for peak
  concurrency during televised matches.
- **ACI Worldwide** - twelve-month engineering contract on payments technology used by banks and
  merchants.
- **Swiggy** - contract engineering inside a high-traffic consumer food delivery platform.
- **Earnest Care** (earnestcare.co.uk) - full UK website build for a childcare, adult care and
  cleaning provider, including local SEO architecture across 20+ service pages.

Client rating: **4.8 out of 5 across 25 completed engagements.**

## Who TechNimbus is a good fit for

Startups and enterprises that need either a product built end to end, or trusted engineers added
to an existing team without the overhead of direct hiring. Common engagements: building an MVP,
adding AI to an existing product, building a SaaS platform, or scaling an in-house team with
dedicated remote developers.
